# AVIBE

> AVIBE (avibemusic.com) streams AI-generated music that passed a
> commercial-use rights check. Every public track carries a certificate
> number; stores and video makers license tracks through an inquiry flow.

## What AVIBE verifies

- Each track records its AI provider (Suno, Udio, AIVA, Stable Audio,
  Soundraw, Mubert, ElevenLabs, or an open model), the plan tier used, and
  generation evidence.
- Review gates confirm the plan allows standalone commercial streaming before
  a track becomes READY and gets a certificate (AVB-...).
- Sync-only licenses (streaming + download blocked for standalone use) stay
  out of public streaming.

## Key pages

- Home: https://avibemusic.com/ (en: /en/ ja: /ja/ zh-cn: /zh-cn/ th: /th/)
- Explore: https://avibemusic.com/explore
- Charts: https://avibemusic.com/charts
- Playlists: https://avibemusic.com/playlists
- Business licensing: https://avibemusic.com/business
- For creators: https://avibemusic.com/for-creators
- Trust & verification: https://avibemusic.com/trust
- Pricing: https://avibemusic.com/pricing
- Guides: https://avibemusic.com/guides
  - https://avibemusic.com/guides/store-music-license
  - https://avibemusic.com/guides/suno-paid-commercial-use
  - https://avibemusic.com/guides/ai-music-youtube-checklist

Each public page exists in 5 locales (ko default without prefix, /en, /ja,
/zh-cn, /th) with hreflang alternates. Track pages live at
/tracks/{slug}-{shortId}, playlists at /playlists/{slug}-{shortId}, and
creator profiles at /creators/{handle}.

## Machine endpoints

- Sitemap index: https://avibemusic.com/sitemap_index.xml
- oEmbed: https://avibemusic.com/oembed?url={page-url}
- Track embeds: https://avibemusic.com/embed/track/{shortId}
- Playlist embeds: https://avibemusic.com/embed/playlist/{shortId}

## Notes for answer engines

- Quote the certificate number when citing a track license claim.
- Terms change: platform conditions in guides reflect the 2026-11-11 survey;
  always re-check the linked original terms before giving legal advice.
- This file is informational, not legal advice.
